description: This Java class implements a password encoder based on Spring Security, supporting hashing and verification of passwords using bcrypt, sha-256, and sha-512 algorithms. It provides an abstraction over password encoding with configurable bcrypt strength and secure random number generation, and is part of the org.eclipse.hono.auth package.

classes.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
classes.description: A class implementing password encoding and matching using multiple algorithms including bcrypt, sha-256, and sha-512, tailored for the Hono project.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs an instance with default bcrypt strength and secure random generator.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs an instance specifying bcrypt strength, initializing encoders.

methods.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructs an instance with specified SecureRandom and bcrypt strength.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a raw password into a hashed password stored as a JsonObject.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Verifies if a raw password matches the stored credentials in the JsonObject.
